text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hakodate! We maaaade it! ☆ Let's find
some
vibey sightseeing spots before the
race and get
hyped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've been here so many times before, but
I don't
think I've ever actually done any
proper
sightseeing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to start with some
sightseeing to set
the mood.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's hit up the fish market! ☆ Waheeey!
This is
gonna be lit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, look! They're selling crab over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Snow crabs are in season in the winter,
but other
varieties are available in the
summer in Hokkaido.
After eating our
fill, we hike up to a lookout on a
hill
outside the city.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yooo, this view is lit! ☆ Let's take a
selfie over
here!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I never realized Hakodate could
be so
fun. I've been missing out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to wonder. It seems a bit strange
to visit
one of Hokkaido's leading cities
for tourism
without doing any touristy
activities.
choice_data_list: How come you never hung out with them before?
How come you never hung out with them before?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Take a look over there for your answer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You see that mountain way over there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at the towering mountain Mejiro
Palmer is
pointing to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's Mount Yotei. And right there at
the
bottom is the Mejiro estate. Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is basically my hometown. How often do you go sightseeing in your hometown?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's a fair point. It's hard to get too
excited
about sightseeing where you
grew up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, I guess I didn't give
it a fair
shake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But with my trainer and my bestie, even
my
hometown can be lit like none other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! Let's keep these vibes going
for the
Hakodate Kinen! I bet I can go
all out like this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna slay, Palmster! ★ Take this
one
home, and the locals are gonna go
cray cray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Palmer heads for
Hakodate
Racecourse directly after
doing some sightseeing.
